raw_segments.text: Fool, why, after I have cut the egg I the middle and eat up the meat, the two crowns
When thou clovest thy crown I the middle and gavst away both parts, thou borst than ass
on thy back o'er the dirt.
Thou hadst little wit in thy bald crown when thou gavst thy golden one away.
If I speak like myself in this, let him be whipped that first finds it so.
